name: TEMPLATE
description: Copy this, rename it, replace every REPLACE_ME. A two-node radio pair: data over the air, ACK back over TCP. Not runnable as it stands — the serials are placeholders.
note: NOT RUNNABLE UNTIL THE SERIALS ARE REPLACED. FILL IN: (1) the two serials, from `uhd_find_devices` on each box. (2) freq_mhz candidates, from `python3 union/phy_profile.py --common` after prepare.sh — list several, best first; the survey picks the first one it measured as usable, so this file does not go stale. (3) subdev/ant must match what prepare.sh surveyed, or the measurement is filed where nothing looks for it. Then: ./run.sh topologies <name> to check it, --print-plan to see what resolved, ./run.sh --algo echo --topology <name> --node snk (receiver first).

nodes.note: transmits only. Its carrier resolves from the RECEIVER's survey — a transmitter is never surveyed, because its own noise says nothing about what the far end hears.
receives and ACKs over TCP. ports.ack is the socket it BINDS; the source dials it. Run prepare.sh against THIS radio.

links.note: For an ACK over the air instead, set down to wireless and give EACH node a second RF block on a DIFFERENT subdev and its own carrier pool (data [2404.5, 2422.5], ack [2440.5, 2422.5]). An RF ACK is the second RF path — same subdev for both directions means the transmitter swamps its own receiver.
